Based on the grid image, here is the step-by-step solution:

1.  **Analyze the Grid**: The letter N is composed of three distinct shapes: two vertical bars (the left and right legs) and a diagonal bar connecting them. The problem states that the side length of a little square is 1, so the area of one small square is $1 \times 1 = 1$.

2.  **Calculate the Area of the Vertical Bars**:
    *   Look at the left vertical bar. It spans 6 small squares vertically and 1 small square horizontally.
    *   Area of left bar $= 6 \text{ squares} \times 1 = 6$.
    *   Look at the right vertical bar. It also spans 6 squares vertically and 1 square horizontally.
    *   Area of right bar $= 6 \text{ squares} \times 1 = 6$.

3.  **Calculate the Area of the Diagonal Bar**:
    *   The diagonal bar is a parallelogram. Its area can be calculated using the formula $\text{Base} \times \text{Height}$.
    *   The vertical height of the parallelogram is 6 units (same as the height of the grid).
    *   The horizontal width (the base perpendicular to the height) spans 1 grid square (from one grid line to the next).
    *   Area of diagonal bar $= \text{Base} \times \text{Height} = 1 \times 6 = 6$.

4.  **Total Area**:
    *   Add the areas of the three parts together:
        $$6 \text{ (left)} + 6 \text{ (right)} + 6 \text{ (diagonal)} = 18$$

The area of the letter N is 18.
